title: My Plan to Make Millions in Crypto This Cycle (And Keep It)
summary: Crypto trader's framework: keep most holdings in a few long-term coins, treat altcoins and memes as trades to sell, and roll gains into index compounding.

assertions.quote: most assets in crypto fall under this category of shorter-term things that you want to eventually sell

verdicts.note: Most altcoins and memecoins have lost the large majority of their value from peak; only a handful have held value across cycles.

assertions.quote: Even at its pico pico top, it was still 30% down in Bitcoin terms than the prior cycle.

verdicts.note: True of most large altcoins across the 2017 and 2021 cycles, with a few exceptions.

assertions.quote: converting it to a long-term compounder is the way that you become generationally wealthy
At ATHs, my portfolio touched 28 million, didn't withdraw anything, and watched it go down to 6 million.

verdicts.note: Unrealized crypto gains routinely reverse by most of their value across cycles.

assertions.quote: if you are good at trading, you can get to a place like this

verdicts.note: A handful of traders do; studies of leveraged retail crypto traders find the large majority lose.
Studies of leveraged retail crypto traders find the large majority lose money, so running small stakes to millions is a lottery outcome.

assertions.quote: I recommend at least 70% of your crypto holdings in that long-term bucket.

verdicts.note: Bitcoin and Ethereum have drawn down 75-85% in bear markets, so the limit is relative.
